svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Locations, alternative B: Warehouse first
svg.desc: Locations step opening on the whole warehouse: headline numbers, nine aisle cards in walk order each with its full bin wall at overview scale, the selected cross-aisle move drawn as one arc from aisle G to aisle A, and the Key.
svg.text: Planning copy after round 1 · data as of 2026-09-30 · aisles in walk order A → I · click an aisle to open its wall
